objectives.heading: What we set out to do on every visit

items.0: Transform homes into spotless and healthy spaces.
items.1: Help clients relax and enjoy their own space.
items.2: Provide deep-cleaning services that exceed expectations.
items.3: Contribute to families' quality of life and peace of mind.

services.heading: Services built around how you actually live
services.description: Choose a single visit or an ongoing plan. Every service can be adjusted to your space, priorities and budget.

residential.title: Residential Cleaning
residential.description: Regular, reliable cleaning that keeps your home fresh week after week.

included.0: Dusting of reachable surfaces, shelves and fixtures
included.1: Kitchen counters, sink, stovetop and exterior of appliances
included.2: Bathroom sinks, tubs, showers, toilets and mirrors
included.3: Vacuuming and mopping of all accessible floors
included.4: Trash removal and general tidying of shared spaces

commercial.title: Commercial Cleaning
commercial.description: Presentable, healthy workspaces for offices, studios and small businesses.

included.2: Restroom sanitizing and restocking of supplies you provide
included.3: Break room counters, sinks and exterior of appliances
included.4: Floor care, trash removal and recycling

deep.title: Deep Cleaning
deep.description: Deep, meticulous cleaning from top to bottom, in the comfort of your space.

included.0: Baseboards, door frames, switch plates and vents
included.1: Detailed bathroom scrubbing including tile and grout lines
included.2: Inside of oven, refrigerator or cabinets on request
included.3: Light fixtures, ceiling fans and reachable window interiors
included.4: Edge vacuuming and detailed floor treatment

organization.title: Home Organization
organization.description: Calm, functional spaces with systems that are easy to maintain.

included.0: Sorting and grouping of items by category and use
included.1: Closet, pantry or cabinet layout planning
included.2: Decluttering support with your decisions guiding every choice
included.3: Labeling and simple systems that are easy to maintain
included.4: Final placement and a walkthrough of the new setup

moveInOut.title: Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning
moveInOut.description: An empty-home clean that makes handing over the keys straightforward.

included.0: Full interior clean of an empty or nearly empty property
included.1: Inside cabinets, drawers, closets and storage areas
included.2: Appliance interiors and exteriors where accessible
included.4: Floors, baseboards and reachable interior windows

custom.title: Customized Plans
custom.description: Personalized services adapted to every need.

included.0: A short conversation about your space and priorities
included.1: A checklist tailored to the rooms that matter most
included.2: Flexible frequency — one-time, seasonal or recurring
included.3: Combination of cleaning and organization as needed
included.4: Plan reviewed together and adjusted whenever things change

hero.title: Two answers and we can get started
hero.subtitle: Tell us the window of time that works for you and the spaces the job covers. We call you back to set the best time to visit.

one.title: Choose your window of time
one.description: Morning, afternoon or evening — whichever block fits your day.

two.title: List your spaces
two.description: Check off the rooms and areas the job should cover, at home or at the office. Anything missing goes under "Other".

three.title: We call to arrange the visit
three.description: Send it through the form, by email, or over the phone. We schedule a call and agree the best time to visit your home or office.

request.heading: What to tell us
